values.formula: weight_g if stated, else CAD body volume (generator manifest) × domains[mechanical].material.density_g_cm3
values.note: 0.02 cm³ × 8.5 g/cm³ (Brass (lead-free, cadmium-free; alloy not stated)); assumption: ruthex names no alloy; 8.5 g/cm³ is within the table's rolled-and-drawn brass range (8.43-8.73) and near 60/40 brass (8.52). The CAD body is the generated nominal shape (19.23 mm³, plain Ø2.0 bore), about 8 % less than the ruthex STEP's 20.95 mm³ with its thread form, so the computed mass (≈ 0.16 g) is about 0.02 g low. Sanity check: ruthex lists a 15 g shipping weight per 70-pack, packaging included, so at most about 0.21 g per insert.

values.formula: weight_g if stated, else CAD body volume (generator manifest) × domains[mechanical].material.density_g_cm3
values.note: 0.02 cm³ × 8 g/cm³ (Stainless steel (grade not stated; 304 / 1.4301 density used)); assumption: Esslinger states only 'stainless steel', so the 304 density is assumed. The CAD body is representative (hollow tube with an assumed 0.2 mm wall, solid plungers, spring omitted), not a measured part; Esslinger states no weight.
